newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 up adjusted 1.57 pct, technical trouble over.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 up adjusted 1.57 pct, technical trouble over.

text.p: The Brussels Stock Exchange, which suffered technical problems with market data earlier on Monday, said the Bel-20 index of leading shares closed up an adjusted 1.57 percent to 1,976.56 points.

"We have now been able to calculate the closing index," deputy director Anne Vleminckx said. "It was an application which all of a sudden had a problem today, which technical staff had to reload." The problem had caused the bourse to readjust closing share prices after prices at the official close at 1530 GMT turned out to be suspect.
